content: Standard idempotent-sync architecture: client- or server-generated idempotency key scoped to one logical operation, checked against a uniqueness constraint before applying, with the stored result returned on retry rather than reapplied; backfill/reprocessing jobs are explicitly named as a source of duplicates requiring the same dedup path as live sync. For a broker-fed journal, the natural idempotency key is the broker's own fill/transaction id — re-running ingest for the same window must be a no-op past the first successful write. Source: general distributed-systems idempotency articles (dev.to, backendbytes, milanjovanovic.tech) — pattern consensus, MEDIUM.
